positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Created new solutions for operating systems and large scale deployment to replace current implementations. Designed and developed a suite of tools to integrate Radmind, a filesystem administration tool, into Gentoo Linux. Utilized problem solving and Bash scripting skills to automate package installation and filesystem administration. Explored virtualization methods to address power concerns and maximize server throughput. Documented design, implementation, general practices, and manuals of projects. Contributed a patch to the Radmind project, which was merged into the mainstream release.

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description: Built and managed the department webserver and the IT staff's internal use storage server. Performed numerous IT services for staff ranging from data recovery to hardware and software installation. Maintained computer lab facilities for the entire department including software loads, licensing, license servers, and hardware.

positions.title: Summer Internship
positions.description: Implemented new features into existing software for analyzing radar images, such as the ability to generate animated graphs, via the gd graphics library, to allow the user to easily visualize data. Identified and rewrote older code requiring refactoring and refinement. Inspected prospective open source solutions to replace propriety wave simulation software and verified usability.

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description: Provided over the phone technical support for dial-up users. Diagnosed and assisted users in correcting connectivity issues.
